definitions.gloss: the start of the rainy season; the beginning of tsuyu
definitions.explanation: the official announcement by the Japan Meteorological Agency marking the beginning of the annual rainy season, typically in early June

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}、{関東地方|かんとうちほう}が{梅雨入|つゆい}りした。
examples.english: Today, the Kanto region entered the rainy season.

examples.japanese: {梅雨入|つゆい}りが{例年|れいねん}より{早|はや}かった。
examples.english: The start of the rainy season was earlier than usual.

examples.japanese: {梅雨入|つゆい}りしたら、{傘|かさ}を{忘|わす}れずに{持|も}ち{歩|ある}こう。
examples.english: Once the rainy season starts, make sure to carry an umbrella.

notes:
FORMATION:
{梅雨|つゆ} (rainy season) + {入|い}り (entering) → entering the rainy season

VERB FORM:
{梅雨入|つゆい}りする (to enter the rainy season)

TIMING:
The Japan Meteorological Agency announces {梅雨入|つゆい}り for each region:
- {沖縄|おきなわ}: early May
- {九州|きゅうしゅう}〜{関東|かんとう}: early to mid-June
- {東北|とうほく}: mid-June
- {北海道|ほっかいどう}: no official rainy season

ALTERNATE READING:
{梅雨入|ついり} (also valid)

RELATED TERMS:
- {梅雨明|つゆあ}け (end of rainy season)
- {梅雨前線|ばいうぜんせん} (rainy season front)
- {空梅雨|からつゆ} (dry rainy season with little rain)
